_about: VOLTA task -> OmniRoute combo routing. The key in OMNIROUTE_API_KEY ('volta-os') is scoped inside OmniRoute to OAuth subscription connections plus the free/local ones, so an API-billed provider (xai, gemini, nous-research, ...) can never be selected by these calls even when a combo lists it. A task tries its chain in order (first failure moves to the next); 'local' (LM Studio) is always the last resort and is appended when a chain does not list it.

research-web.note: No live web search through OmniRoute for an OAuth-only key (/v1/search needs API-key search providers, which this key may not use). Answers are knowledge-only (liveWeb:false in the result); keep claude -p with WebSearch/WebFetch where real browsing is required.

long-write.note: Podcast scripts, outlines, long-form drafts. SmartSpread spreads across the OAuth subscriptions.

quick.note: Labels, summaries, triage. Local qwen first so no subscription is touched. free-stack is currently dead while OmniRoute's Claude OAuth is expired (its first member 401s and the priority combo stops), so 'balanced' (cheaper least-used members) backs it up.

video-prompts.note: The video combo lists gemini/* (Google AI Studio API key) as members 3 and 4; the volta-os key cannot use that connection, so only Antigravity answers.

vm-stage-a.note: Voltamachine Stage A and Volta Research PDF abstracts. Dedicated OmniRoute combo (grok-4.7, gemini flash, gpt-5.6-terra, grok-cli); no Claude, no API-billed provider.

vm-stage-b.note: Voltamachine Stage B cross-document synthesis. Dedicated OmniRoute combo, strongest OAuth models first; no Claude, no API-billed provider.

verified.how: POST /api/llm/complete per task, prompt 'Reply with exactly: pong'
